title: Sessions page: the grid uses the screen, the footer becomes a status rail, year/month/day scoping, a left rail for sub-views

chat.text: Measured first, then fixed: the first row of the sessions grid moves into the top quarter of the page, the 200-plus pixel near-empty footer becomes a one-line status rail, the useless inbox link goes, left padding matches the gutter; year, month and day become breadcrumb routes that scope the list with month as the default, newest first; sub-views (docs, other dashboard versions, health, cost) sit in a left rail instead of a second tab row. Before and after screenshots at four widths.

message.text:
task-mastermind-sessions-page-layout: Most of the Sessions layout work is merged into `michael/dev`. One small CSS follow-up that tidies the footer status line is not merged yet.

The merge gate refused it because a page change needs a full review report with screenshots. I'm running a light review for it now, then I'll merge, re-measure at four widths, and put the before/after numbers on the card.

task-mastermind-sessions-page-layout: I'm fixing the Sessions page layout. The header, scope filters, left rail and status footer are already merged into `michael/dev`. I'm landing one last CSS tweak that shrinks the status footer to a single row.

That tweak is blocked at the merge gate, which wants a page review report with screenshots before it will take a page change. I'm getting that review done now. After it merges I'll re-measure at four widths and put the before/after on the card.
